tasks.title: UART capacity
tasks.statement: A UART at **{baud}** baud, 8N1 (10 bits per byte). How many frames of **{n}** bytes per second can it pass in theory?
tasks.solution: Bytes/s = baud/10; divide by the frame size.

tasks.title: Link latency
tasks.statement: One-way 4G latency is **{d} ms**, onboard processing **{p} ms**. What is the RTT of a command until COMMAND_ACK is received (ms)?
